recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-50611 notes update in core while leaving broader specimenSuggestion extension maintenance to the Extension Pack issues and the already-published FHIR-55444 audit/removal work.
issue_request: FHIR-50611 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and requested updates to the ServiceRequest Notes section after ServiceRequest.specimen was deprecated, replacing the old specimen guidance with Specimen.request, ServiceRequest bodyStructure, and the servicerequest-specimenSuggestion extension, including links for the replacement references.
initial_application: The issue was mostly applied before this reconciliation. Commit 8d4558f263d3b8d3cf2ff2c72e39cb51a4bba297 rewrote source/servicerequest/servicerequest-notes.xml to remove the old ServiceRequest.specimen recommendation and add the Specimen.request, bodyStructure, and specimenSuggestion guidance; commit 7afa7eb6479d46ba27a05f7848d648f89d83e165 fixed the resulting bodyStructure typo; merge commit d84f0570d3a72af3058f9d57f6a118f7c5c15fde brought that work in through PR #3509. The initial application included a Specimen.request link but left the requested specimenSuggestion extension reference as unlinked text.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/servicerequest/servicerequest-notes.xml is authoritative narrative input. FHIR-34206 introduced the specimenSuggestion replacement concept and the FHIR Extension Pack checkout now contains input/definitions/ServiceRequest/StructureDefinition-servicerequest-specimenSuggestion.xml. Later FHIR-52987 published Extension Pack clarifications for that extension, while FHIR-55444 removed ServiceRequest.specimen from the core StructureDefinition and is already represented on the combined branch. OO WGM minutes for 2025-05-12/15 record the FHIR-50611 motion and wording discussion, and no directly conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Added Extension Pack links to both servicerequest-specimenSuggestion references in source/servicerequest/servicerequest-notes.xml using the existing [%extensions-location%] macro. No additional wording was changed.
